summary: Keeps a fixed width/height ratio; inner images, videos and iframes cover the box.
whenToUse: Media previews, maps, embedded videos, card covers.
whenNotToUse: Text content of variable height: it may get clipped.
inherits: HTML attributes of <div>; ref to the <div>.
accessibility: Inner images still need an appropriate alt; iframes need a title.
responsive: Width is fluid; height derives from the ratio (CSS aspect-ratio property).
commonMistakes: Adding long text that gets clipped on narrow viewports.
